answer: Deposit + arbitration forfeiture. Each identity must lock a 500 USD escrow deposit and bind it to a government-ID hash via an OASIS SAML assertion; the escrow state is written as a trellis-code audit trail on a Juniper Networks firewall log before voting/grading. A farm of 1000 clones binds 1000 deposits = 500,000 USD, and an arbitration verdict forfeits all 500,000 USD upon detection of the clone pattern. Honesty stays cheaper.
